specials.name: Uzumaki Rendan

koma.support_effect: Performs the Uzumaki Rendan; 30 damage to power/laughter characters, 45 damage to knowledge characters.

moves.name: Guard break
moves.description: Naruto's guard break is a ranged attack, which is good because most guard break attacks only work up close.
moves.quote: Naruto's guard break is fortunately, a ranged attack. This is good because most guard break attacks only work if the opponent is right in front of you.

moves.name: Ultimate Action
moves.description: Lets Naruto absorb one hit for free while the wood icon in the bottom left corner is still showing. Best used against opponents with rapid-punching specials: get hit once, then teleport behind them and attack.
moves.quote: Naruto's ultimate action lets you get hit once if you get hit while the wood icon on the bottom left corner is still there. I only suggest using the ultimate action when you're opponent has a rapid punching special... If you get hit while they are punching you with X, teleport behind them and attack them from there.

unresolved: The guide never mentions a down+B forced-switch attack for Naruto; omitted rather than guessed.
The guide describes a ranged 'guard break' but never states which input (B/Y/X direction) triggers it; recorded as input 'other' with no damage value.

The guide labels the koma-4/5/6 specials only as 'Special A' and 'Special B', never naming a button input. Inputs 'X' (Special A) and 'up X' (Special B) in this file are inferred from the combo notation ('B, B^, X^' and 'B, B^, X') in section III/V, not stated explicitly by the guide as button codes.

4 koma has two nature variants (power and laughter) with identical Special A/B base damage, but the laughter-version combo 'B, B^, X^' is listed as 60(P)/70(K)/52(L) -- a three-way split rather than the usual power/laughter-vs-knowledge split used everywhere else in the guide. Kept verbatim in combos; not reconciled.
No koma HP values are given anywhere in this guide.
No version number is stated for this FAQ; only a 2007 copyright year appears.

Ally boost section (Sakura, Gaara, Jiraiya) describes other characters' help/support effects as they apply to a Naruto deck, not Naruto's own moves; included here only as background, not as Naruto koma/move entries.
